title: Kilimanjaro Climb and Serengeti Adventure
content:
Embark on an unforgettable journey that combines the thrill of summiting Mount Kilimanjaro via the Machame Route with an exhilarating safari adventure through Tanzania’s iconic national parks. Begin your experience with a warm welcome in Moshi, where you’ll prepare for the trek amidst serene accommodations.

The climb takes you through diverse landscapes, from lush rainforests to the breathtaking heights of Uhuru Peak, Africa’s highest summit. Along the way, expert guides and porters ensure your safety and comfort, offering a seamless and rewarding experience.

After conquering Kilimanjaro, transition to an extraordinary safari adventure that showcases Tanzania’s renowned wildlife. Explore the diverse ecosystems of Lake Manyara, the vast plains of the Serengeti, and the unique Ngorongoro Crater.

Encounter iconic wildlife such as lions, elephants, and giraffes, guided by experienced rangers who enhance every game drive. Luxurious lodges and camps provide the perfect balance of relaxation and immersion in nature. This 15-day itinerary delivers the ultimate Tanzanian experience, blending adventure, wildlife, and cultural exploration.

Where you stay

At Salinero Hotels we do not believe in numbers but we do believe in a service keeping our few customers happy around the clock. Salinero Kilimanjaro is Located 3 Km from Moshi town center in the Leafy suburb of shanty town.

The hotel now blends in simplistic elegance with perfect architectural designs all combined to entice even the most seasoned traveller. Now operating as a 30-room unit, we ensure that clients enjoy personalized service around the clock whilst staying with us. Our well manicured gardens provide the ample settings for your wedding reception or any other special event that you may have.

Endoro Lodge is an Eco friendly safari lodge located on the slops of Ngorongoro highland forest. We have beautiful chalet rooms which are uniquely designed to give our clients an authentic African experience. Our highly skilled stuff uphold the slogan which is integrate with nature for they are all dressed in authentic Masai cloths.

Welcome to our enchanting midrange tented camp, a hidden gem in the heart of the Central Serengeti. Our lodge offers a perfect blend of rustic charm and modern comfort, providing a memorable safari experience for our guests. We invite you to embark on a journey of discovery, where the wonders of nature meet the comforts of home for an unforgettable safari getaway.

Matawi Serengeti Camp is celebrated for its top-notch service, with guests often commending the staff’s exceptional attentiveness and professionalism. The camp’s ambiance is described as a luxurious sanctuary, offering spacious and well-equipped tents that provide the perfect respite for travelers.

Despite mixed reviews on value, many visitors are enchanted by the clean and opulent rooms, as well as the unique wildlife experiences the location affords. The camp’s food and overall cleanliness receive high marks, enhancing its reputation as a premium destination in the heart of the Serengeti.

Is located in the south of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, approx 50km south-west of karatu Town. The Lodge is composed of 10 comfortable luxury tents to accommodate 2guest each, as well as large dining and reception area. Where is the Ngorongoro Conservation Area? The Ngorongoro Conservation Area spans vast expanses of highland plains, savanna, savanna woodlands, and forests.

Ngorongoro Wild Camp is located in the South of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, Approx. 50 km south – west of Karatu Town. The permanent camp is composed of 20 comfortable luxury tents and 6 cottages, as well as large dining and reception area.

The unique and comfortable Ngorongoro Wild Camps offer Various contemporary amenities such as Dining & Bar Activities, internet, Sundowner cocktails to Bush meals at a private site, fireplace, Maasai barbecue, Ngorongoro Multi-cuisine restaurant provide a memorable wild experience.

faqs.title: What is included in the Tanzania Combo Package?
faqs.content: Our Tanzania Combo Packages include a combination of a Mount Kilimanjaro climb, a thrilling safari experience, and a relaxing stay in Zanzibar. We provide expert guides, park fees, accommodation, meals, and transportation for the entire trip, so you can focus on enjoying your adventure. You can customize your itinerary based on your preferences.

faqs.title: How long does the combo trip last?
faqs.content: The length of the combo trip varies depending on the itinerary you choose. Typically, the Kilimanjaro climb takes 6 to 8 days, followed by 3 to 4 days on safari in top parks like Serengeti and Ngorongoro Crater, and 4 to 5 days in Zanzibar. The total trip can range from 10 to 14 days, depending on your preferences.

faqs.title: Do I need any prior experience for climbing Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: No prior climbing experience is required. However, you should be in good physical condition to handle the altitude and trekking. Our guides will support you throughout the climb, and we recommend some fitness training before your trip. The right preparation will help ensure a safe and enjoyable climb.

faqs.title: What are the best months to visit Tanzania for the combo package?
faqs.content: The best time to visit Tanzania for a combo trip is during the dry seasons, typically from June to October and December to February. These months offer ideal weather for both climbing Mount Kilimanjaro and going on safari, as wildlife is easier to spot, and the conditions are favorable for trekking.

faqs.title: Can I customize my safari experience within the combo package?
faqs.content: Yes! Our combo packages are flexible, and you can customize your safari experience based on your interests. Whether you want to focus on seeing the Big Five, experiencing the Great Migration, or enjoying a private safari with a personal guide, we can tailor the safari to your preferences.

faqs.title: What type of accommodation can I expect during the combo trip?
faqs.content: We offer a variety of accommodation options based on your comfort preferences. For the Kilimanjaro trek, you’ll stay in mountain huts or camping facilities. On safari, you can enjoy luxury lodges and tented camps, depending on your choice. In Zanzibar, we provide a range of options from beachfront resorts to boutique hotels, ensuring a comfortable and relaxing stay.

itinerary.title: Day 1
itinerary.content:
Upon your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our attentive driver will be eagerly waiting to greet you, holding a sign with your name, prepared to extend a warm and welcoming reception. From there, you’ll experience a smooth and comfortable transfer to the Hotel.

Once you arrive at the hotel, you’ll be treated to a delicious meal to help you relax and refresh after your journey. Later, our experienced mountain coordinators and guide will meet with you for an informative pre-trek briefing, offering an exciting glimpse into the incredible adventure ahead.Immerse yourself in the serene ambiance of the Hotel, featuring a beautiful garden, a relaxing swimming pool, a bar, and a restaurant, creating the perfect environment for unwinding before your expedition begins.

Overnight: Sal salinero hotel or similar

itinerary.title: Day 2
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 910 meters (2,985 feet) - 3,000 meters (9,840 feet)
  • Hiking distance: 11 km
  • Hiking time: 6 hours

After enjoying breakfast and a briefing at your hotel, you’ll set off on a 45-minute journey from Moshi to the Machame Park Gate. Upon arrival, the registration process will be completed, and you’ll receive your packed lunch. The adventure begins with your ascent through the vibrant rainforest, where the path may become muddy and slick if there has been recent rainfall.

The trek to Machame Camp spans roughly 11 kilometers and usually takes around six hours. In the evening, porters will prepare hot water for drinking and washing, while the cook will serve up dinner. As night falls, temperatures may drop close to freezing, so you’ll settle into your tent for a cold but fulfilling night’s rest.

itinerary.title: Day 3
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,000 meters (9,840 feet) - 3,840 meters (12,598 feet)
  • Hiking distance: 5 km
  • Hiking time: 4 to 5 hours

After enjoying breakfast at Machame Camp, you’ll set off towards Shira Camp, covering about 5 kilometers in a journey that typically takes 4 to 5 hours. The trail begins with a steep ascent through the scenic moorland zone, where you’ll be treated to breathtaking views as you climb.

As you near Shira Camp, you’ll walk along a ridge offering spectacular vistas of the surrounding landscape. Upon arrival, the porters will set up your tents and prepare lunch. You’ll have the afternoon to relax and acclimate to the altitude before dinner, followed by a briefing from your guide on the next day’s trek.

itinerary.title: Day 4
itinerary.desc: Shira Camp to Lava Tower to Barranco Camp
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,840 meters (12,598 feet) - 4,630 meters (15,190 feet) - 3,960 meters (12,992 feet)
  • Hiking distance: 11 km
  • Hiking time: 7 to 8 hours

After breakfast at Shira Camp, you’ll set off on a demanding trek to Lava Tower, ascending to an altitude of 4,630 meters. This hike spans approximately 11 kilometers and typically takes around 7 to 8 hours, featuring rocky, semi-desert terrain. Along the way, take in the panoramic views during your lunch stop at Lava Tower.

Afterward, you’ll descend to Barranco Camp, situated at 3,960 meters. This descent lasts about 2 hours and offers stunning vistas of the Western Breach. Upon reaching Barranco Camp, the team will set up your tents and prepare dinner. In the evening, your guide will provide a briefing about the next day’s trek, ensuring you’re well-prepared for the adventures that lie ahead.

itinerary.title: Day 5
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,960 m – 4,035 m
  • Hiking distance: 5 km
  • Hiking time: 5 hours

Start your day early with a wake-up call, followed by a hearty breakfast to energize you for the trek ahead. You may encounter the renowned Barranco Wall, a steep ascent that offers a rewarding challenge.

Once you’ve conquered the Wall, you’ll make your way down into the picturesque Karanga Valley, celebrated for its lush greenery and stunning views. Upon arrival at the Karanga campsite, the porters will set up your tents while our chef prepares a delicious lunch.

After your meal, you’ll undertake an acclimatization hike toward Barafu Camp, gaining an elevation of 200 meters before returning to your campsite. In the evening, savor a warm dinner crafted by our chef. Following your meal, your knowledgeable guide will provide a briefing on the next day’s trek, outlining the route, anticipated challenges, and essential details to help you prepare.

itinerary.title: Day 6
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 4,035 m – 4,640 m
  • Hiking distance: 5 km
  • Hiking time: 5 hours

Begin your day with an early wake-up call and a substantial breakfast to prepare for your trek to Barafu campsite. The trail presents diverse terrain, featuring rocky patches and gentle inclines, all while showcasing stunning views of Kilimanjaro’s high-altitude scenery.

As you ascend, prioritize acclimatization to prevent altitude sickness.Upon your arrival at Barafu, our porters will take care of setting up the camp while the chef prepares a nourishing lunch. After your meal, take some time to relax until dinner.

In the evening, your guide will provide a detailed briefing regarding the forthcoming summit attempt, discussing the route, potential challenges, safety protocols, and necessary preparations. Be sure to rest well, as the summit ascent is scheduled to begin late in the evening.

itinerary.title: Day 7
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 4,640 m – 5, 895 m – 3,090 m
  • Hiking distance: 17 km
  • Hiking time: 15+ hours

You’ll begin your ascent around 11:30 PM, starting with some tea and biscuits to fuel your energy. As you head northwest, you’ll navigate through scree on your way to Stella Point on the crater rim. This 6-hour trek to Stella Point (5,685 meters) is often considered the most mentally and physically demanding section of the climb.

Once you reach Stella Point, take a moment to enjoy the breathtaking sunrise, conditions permitting. From there, you’ll continue on a snow-covered path for an additional 2-hour climb to Uhuru Peak. Be mindful of your time at the summit, as weather conditions may dictate how long you can stay; it’s important not to linger too long due to the cold and the fatigue you’ll experience.

The descent to Barafu takes approximately 3 hours, where you’ll have a brief rest before continuing on to Mweka Camp for dinner and your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 8
itinerary.desc: MWEKA CAMP | MWEKA PARK GATE | MOSHI
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,090 m – 1,650 m
  • Hiking distance: 10 km
  • Hiking time: 4-5 hours

After enjoying breakfast at Mweka Camp, you’ll begin your descent to Mweka Gate, where a vehicle will be waiting to take you back to the hotel. There, you’ll be greeted with a hot lunch and a refreshing shower, the perfect way to unwind after your trek.

At the conclusion of your journey, tipping the team is encouraged and appreciated; special envelopes for this purpose will be available at the hotel. As this is a combo package, you will receive a pre-safari briefing in the late afternoon.

Our safari coordinator will meet with you at the hotel to provide detailed information about your upcoming safari adventure and answer any questions you may have. This briefing will ensure you’re fully prepared for the exciting experiences ahead!

Overnight: Salinero Hotel or Similar

itinerary.title: Day 9
itinerary.content:
This morning, you’ll drive to Lake Manyara National Park at the foot of the Rift Valley’s dramatic escarpment. The park is known for its diverse landscapes, including evergreen groundwater forests, acacia woodlands, grassy plains, a swampy fan delta, and the expansive lake that dominates the landscape.

This variety of ecosystems creates a haven for wildlife, attracting a wide range of species. You’ll encounter buffalo, impala, giraffes, bushbuck, waterbuck, hippos, and large herds of elephants near the lake as you explore. The park is also famous for its rare tree-climbing lions, which are often spotted lounging in the branches of acacia trees.

In addition, be on the lookout for blue monkeys, vervet monkeys, and lively troops of Olive baboons as they move through the park’s diverse habitats. Lake Manyara offers excellent opportunities for game viewing, with its stunning scenery and rich wildlife providing a memorable safari experience.

Overnight: Enduro Lodge or similar

itinerary.title: Day 10
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, you’ll head to Serengeti, one of Africa’s most famous wildlife destinations. The scenic drive takes you through breathtaking landscapes, transitioning into the Serengeti’s vast plains. Along the way, enjoy a game drive where you might spot lions, leopards, elephants, rhinos, and buffalos, often called the “Big Five.”

Cheetahs, giraffes, zebras, and many other species add to the thrill of exploring the Serengeti’s rich biodiversity. By evening, you’ll reach the Matawi Serengeti Camp or similar accommodations, where you can relax and enjoy the serene atmosphere. It’s the perfect spot to reflect on the day’s wildlife adventures and prepare for the next.

Overnight: Serengeti central lodge, Matawi serengeti Camp or Similar

itinerary.title: Day 11
itinerary.content:
Prepare for a full day of exploration in the Serengeti! After an early breakfast, embark on morning and afternoon game drives across the iconic savannas. The Serengeti offers unmatched opportunities for wildlife viewing, where you’ll have the chance to see large prides of lions, and leopards lounging in acacia trees, and herds of wildebeest and zebra roaming the plains.

Your guide will help you track the movements of different animals, potentially witnessing hunting scenes and interactions that reveal the complex dynamics of the Serengeti ecosystem. Enjoy a picnic lunch amid the park’s breathtaking landscapes, then continue your adventure until sunset. Return to your lodge for a restful evening under the Serengeti stars.

Overnight: Serengeti central lodge, Matawi serengeti Camp or Similar

itinerary.title: Day 12
itinerary.content:
Immerse yourself in the wonders of the Serengeti with another full day of exploration! Begin with an early breakfast before heading out for morning and afternoon game drives across the park’s vast plains. This second day offers a deeper chance to experience the Serengeti’s incredible wildlife, from towering giraffes grazing near acacia trees to cheetahs sprinting across open grasslands.

Your guide will take you to different areas of the park, enhancing your chances of seeing elusive species and observing unique wildlife behaviors. Pause for a picnic lunch in a scenic spot before continuing your journey through the park’s diverse habitats. As the day winds down, enjoy the breathtaking Serengeti sunset before returning to your lodge for a relaxing evening.

Overnight: Serengeti central lodge, Matawi serengeti Camp or Similar

itinerary.title: Day 13
itinerary.desc: Morning Game Drive and Transfer to Ngorongoro
itinerary.content:
Start your day with a morning game drive in the Serengeti, making the most of the cooler hours when wildlife is most active. This is a great opportunity to spot predators like lions or cheetahs on the move and witness the beauty of the Serengeti one last time.

After the game drive, enjoy a scenic drive to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Upon arrival, settle into your accommodation at Ngorongoro Safari Lodge, Ngorongoro Wild Camp, or a similar lodge, where you can relax and prepare for the next day’s adventure.

Overnight: Ngorongoro Safari Lodge, Ngorongoro Wild Camp, or similar

itinerary.title: Day 14
itinerary.desc: Ngorongoro Crater Exploration and Transfer to Karatu
itinerary.content:
Start your day with an exciting journey into the Ngorongoro Crater, one of Africa’s most famous wildlife destinations and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Descend into this vast, natural caldera, often called the “Eighth Wonder of the World,” where you’ll experience a thriving ecosystem unlike any other. During your game drive, you’ll have the chance to see a diverse range of wildlife, including lions, elephants, rhinos, and large herds of wildebeest and zebras. Don’t miss the vibrant flocks of flamingos that gather along the shores of the crater’s central lake.

After a memorable day of wildlife encounters, you’ll head out of the crater and drive to the charming Karatu area. Here, you’ll settle in for a restful evening at Endoro Lodge or a similar lodge, surrounded by the serene beauty of the countryside. Relax and prepare for the next leg of your adventure.

Overnight: Endoro Lodge or similar

itinerary.title: Day 15
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, you’ll be transferred to Kilimanjaro International Airport, where your journey began, for your departure. Reflect on the incredible experiences and memories you’ve made during your adventure.

For those wishing to extend their trip, there are exciting options available. You can explore nearby attractions through one of the day trips featured on our Day Trip page, offering cultural, scenic, or adventurous activities. Alternatively, you can embark on a Zanzibar excursion, where you’ll enjoy pristine beaches, rich history, and vibrant culture.

If you choose the Zanzibar extension, we’ll arrange your transfer to Arusha Airport for your flight to Zanzibar on this same day. Visit our Zanzibar page to discover the perfect package for your next adventure.
